assumptions: Scanned vanilla definitions must match the currently loaded game.
NO LANDMARK CANDIDATE IS A PRODUCTION SOURCE: all 26 native country-modifier bindings are retained only as unavailable audit candidates.
Native national totals still include the engine's true landmark effects; this adapter does not add, subtract, or replace totals.
Only landmark country_modifiers were audited; no state or unit modifier is counted.

Three engine probes found provincial landmark dynamic level queries return zero, STATE non_damaged_building_level rejects landmarks, native counts retain damaged copies, and COUNTRY has_damaged_buildings misses damaged provincial landmarks.
A damaged landmark can pass every tested candidate predicate while its true national effect is zero; no candidate activation is emitted into by_modifier.
Country-status curves read the documented native has_stability/has_war_support numeric queries; inputs use the 0..1 range, never a cached substitute or source sum.
Runtime_validated is false at generation; deployment requires corresponding engine probes.
No dedicated current-state query for pride of the fleet or coastal protection was found in the shipped public documentation; no attribution is inferred from totals or fleet existence.

evidence.claim: country_modifiers are enabled for the actual controller, separately from state_modifiers.
Building count triggers support COUNTRY and STATE scope, including all native landmarks.
Vanilla scripted localisation itself tests landmark_tokyo_imperial_palace > 0 in state scope; lines367/384 likewise test National Diet and Hakko Ichiu.
STATE scope documents building level numeric queries, but the first engine probe found zero for provincial landmarks; those queries are not used for landmark attribution.
The STATE non_damaged_building_level trigger is documented for state buildings; the second engine probe rejected provincial landmarks, so the adapter does not use it.
has_damaged_buildings is a COUNTRY predicate, but the third engine probe found it does not detect damaged provincial landmarks; it cannot establish landmark health.
COUNTRY numeric queries has_stability and has_war_support are auto-generated from the native triggers; their documented range is 0..1.
has_war is the COUNTRY-scope predicate for whether the country is at war; no means peace.
MIN_STABILITY/MAX_STABILITY and MIN_WAR_SUPPORT/MAX_WAR_SUPPORT define the native 0..1 bounds.
clamp_temp_variable is permitted in triggers; effect documentation line2681 specifies var/min/max syntax.
Native stability curves are split at 50%; their literal endpoint effects are in the static definitions.

engine_probe_observations.observation: Any tested damage disabled the full 0.05 national effect; no proportional 0.025 effect was observed.
engine_probe_observations.rejected_query: STATE building_level@ / damaged_building_level@ / non_damaged_building_level@ all returned zero for this provincial building.
engine_probe_observations.rejected_comparator: Native building count trigger rejected '=' as Not valid compare token.
engine_probe_observations.candidate_verification: The second engine probe rejected the non_damaged_building_level predicate for provincial landmarks; see the later observation.

engine_probe_observations.observation: Native country/state/province building counts stay one while intact, partly damaged, and fully damaged; they become zero only after removal.
engine_probe_observations.rejected_predicate: STATE non_damaged_building_level rejected the provincial landmark with Not a valid state building: building.
engine_probe_observations.candidate_verification: The COUNTRY has_damaged_buildings fallback was subsequently disproved by the third engine probe.

engine_probe_observations.observation: has_damaged_buildings = no remained true for partly and fully damaged landmarks while their native national contribution was zero; it became false only when an unrelated factory was damaged.
engine_probe_observations.rejected_predicate: COUNTRY has_damaged_buildings = no cannot prove a provincial landmark is intact.
engine_probe_observations.production_action: All 26 landmark bindings are removed from by_modifier and retained only in unavailable_landmark_candidates; no residual or guessed substitute is displayed.
